about.label: MY JOURNEY
about.title: From technology enthusiast to developer
about.subtitle: A software engineer driven by curiosity — from the first lines of Python at school to smart contracts in production at a blockchain company.
about.background_p1: My journey in technology began at a very young age, when I received my first computer at the age of eight and spent countless hours exploring, experimenting, and trying to understand how things worked. What started as simple curiosity soon became a genuine passion for technology.
about.background_p2: My first formal contact with programming happened at school, where I learned the basics through Scratch and later wrote my very first "Hello World" in Python in 2017. By my last year of high school, I had already decided that Computer Science would be my future, and from that moment on, I fully immersed myself in learning how to code.
about.background_p3: Since then, I have explored areas such as web and mobile development, building applications and strengthening my foundations in software engineering. Eventually, I chose to specialize in Web3, as I believe in the future of a decentralized internet and the potential of blockchain technologies. Today, I combine academic knowledge with hands-on experience to turn ideas into impactful digital products.

timeline.2017_desc: Had my first experience with programming using Scratch during school classes, discovering the basics of logic and creativity.
timeline.2019_desc: Began learning Python at school, exploring programming logic and building simple automation scripts.
timeline.2020_desc: Started learning JavaScript independently, building Discord bots and creating my first personal websites.
timeline.2023_desc: Returned to active development, focusing on web projects and strengthening my skills with React.
timeline.2024_desc: In my final year of high school, resumed intensive studies, advanced in web development, and started learning Java.
timeline.2025a_desc: Started my Computer Science degree with a strong foundation, focusing on full-stack development and beginning my journey in data and AI with PyTorch.
timeline.2025b_desc: Worked on automating internal banking processes using Python, AWS, and React, improving efficiency and reliability across systems.
timeline.2025c_desc: By the end of 2025, I pivoted toward Web3 because I strongly believe in the long-term potential of blockchain technology, focusing mainly on EVM-based development.
timeline.2026_desc: Developing and maintaining smart contracts, primarily for EVM-compatible chains, and contributing to the Web3 product stack with a focus on security, reliability, and developer experience.
